## What drives it

### Untargeted calling is a leak
Baseline conversion 11.7% over 45,211 dials; AI targeting lifts the top decile 6.06x.

### Timing beats volume
May = peak contacts at bottom-tier conversion; autumn shoulder months convert while dialing volume collapses — rebalancing the calendar is free.

### Audience quality spread
Profession segments differ up to ~5x in conversion; knowing the list (contact class) outperforms unknown.
